lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਮੈਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n)budh duramat hai mailee bin gur bhavajal pheraa ||3||
lines.translation: They are proud and arrogant, evil-minded and filthy; without the Guru, they are reincarnated into the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hom jag jap tap sabh sa(n)jam tat teerath nahee paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Through burnt offerings, charitable feasts, ritualistic chants, penance, all sorts of austere self-discipline and pilgrimages to sacred shrines and rivers, they do not find God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਪੁ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: mitiaa aap pae saranaaee guramukh naanak jagat taraaiaa ||4||1||14||
lines.translation: Self-conceit is only erased when one seeks the Lord's Sanctuary and becomes Gurmukh; O Nanak, he crosses over the world-ocean. ||4||1||14||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਉਦਾਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ban mahi pekhio trin mahi pekhio grihi pekhio udaasaae ||
lines.translation: I have seen Him in the woods, and I have seen Him in the fields. I have seen Him in the household, and in renunciation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੰਡਧਾਰ ਜਟਧਾਰੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਤੀਰਥਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: da(n)dadhaar jatadhaarai pekhio varat nem teerathaae ||1||
lines.translation: I have seen Him as a Yogi carrying His staff, as a Yogi with matted hair, fasting, making vows, and visiting sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||
I have seen Him in the Society of the Saints, and within my own mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਸਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: oobh paiaal sarab mahi pooran ras ma(n)gal gun gaae ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the sky, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in everything, He is pervading and permeating. With love and joy, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਭੇਖ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਜਤਿ ਜੰਗਮ ਕਾਪੜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jog bhekh sa(n)niaasai pekhio jat ja(n)gam kaapaRaae ||
lines.translation: I have seen Him among the Yogis, the Sannyaasees, the celibates, the wandering hermits and the wearers of patched coats.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਪੀ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਨਟ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਨਿਰਤਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tapee tapeesur mun mahi pekhio nat naatik nirataae ||2||
lines.translation: I have seen Him among the men of severe self-discipline, the silent sages, the actors, dramas and dances. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਖਟ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਦਸ ਅਸਟੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: chahu mahi pekhio khat mahi pekhio das asatee si(n)mritaae ||
lines.translation: I have seen Him in the four Vedas, I have seen Him in the six Shaastras, in the eighteen Puraanas and the Simritees as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਨਹਿ ਤਉ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਉ ਦੁਰਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mil eko ek vakhaanahi tau kis te kahau duraae ||3||
lines.translation: All together, they declare that there is only the One Lord. So tell me, from whom is He hidden? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਹ ਅਗਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਹ ਕੀਮ ਕੀਮ ਕੀਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: agah agah bea(n)t suaamee nah keem keem keemaae ||
lines.translation: Unfathomable and Inaccessible, He is our Infinite Lord and Master; His Value is beyond valuation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੀਆਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tin kai bal bal jaaeeai jih ghat paragateeaae ||4||2||15||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those, within whose heart He is revealed. ||4||2||15||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nikat bujhai so buraa kiu karai ||
lines.translation: How can anyone do evil, if he realizes that the Lord is near?
One who gathers corruption, constantly feels fear.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਨਿਕਟੇ ਅਰੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hai nikate ar bhed na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: He is near, but this mystery is not understood.
Without the True Guru, all are enticed by Maya. ||1||
Everyone says that He is near, near at hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh bhed viralaa ko lahai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: But rare is that person, who, as Gurmukh, understands this mystery. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nikat na dekhai par grihi jaai ||
lines.translation: The mortal does not see the Lord near at hand; instead, he goes to the homes of others.
He steals their wealth and lives in falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paee thagauree har sa(n)g na jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Under the influence of the drug of illusion, he does not know that the Lord is with him.
Without the Guru, he is confused and deluded by doubt. ||2||
Not understanding that the Lord is near, he tells lies.
In love and attachment to Maya, the fool is plundered.
That which he seeks is within his own self, but he looks for it outside.
Without the Guru, he is confused and deluded by doubt. ||3||
One whose good karma is recorded on his forehead
serves the True Guru; thus the hard and heavy shutters of his mind are opened wide.
Within his own being and beyond, he sees the Lord near at hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak aavai na jaavai koi ||4||3||16||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, he does not come and go in reincarnation. ||4||3||16||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis too raakhahi tis kaun maarai ||
lines.translation: Who can kill that person whom You protect, O Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh tujh hee a(n)tar sagal sa(n)saarai ||
lines.translation: All beings, and the entire universe, is within You.
The mortal thinks up millions of plans,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਕਰੈ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so hovai j karai choj vidaanee ||1||
lines.translation: but that alone happens, which the Lord of wondrous plays does. ||1||
Save me, save me, O Lord; shower me with Your Mercy.
I seek Your Sanctuary, and Your Court. ||1||Pause||
Whoever serves the Fearless Lord, the Giver of Peace,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਏਕੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin bhau door keeaa ek paraataa ||
lines.translation: is rid of all his fears; he knows the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo too karahi soee phun hoi ||
lines.translation: Whatever You do, that alone comes to pass in the end.
There is no other who can kill or protect us. ||2||
What do you think, with your human understanding?
The All-knowing Lord is the Searcher of Hearts.
The One and only Lord is my Support and Protection.
The Creator Lord knows everything. ||3||
That person who is blessed by the Creator's Glance of Grace
